items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: Bunk, they all have played for me.

ctx.x: Well, how often did you play with Kid Ari?

Not much. Once in a while I played with the band. Oh. And again. Kid Ari used to play for me. I had a, I had a dancing place, you know? Mmhmm. An evening dance, he used to play for me. Mmhmm. Across from my shop. First Liberty, you been there. First Liberty. Yeah. Oh, yeah. Sure, I was in the barbershop. Or is, Or is a play for me. I, in fact, uh, Kid Oliver, Orie, Ben, and, uh, Kid Oliver, Orie, uh-huh. Uh-huh. Bunk, they all have played for me. I was still playing with you, but I, I was building on the other…
You know, I believe that's a 12 string guitar that Stone has that, Bill? Yeah.
